high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "arunaguhan." The post was shared 5 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post includes a message from the account "avmproductionsofficial," which appears to be a collaboration between AVM Studios and Nag Ashwin. Content of the Post: The post announces that AVM Studios x Nag Ashwin is looking for Associate Directors based in Hyderabad for a new project. It provides an email address, "project-s@avm.co.in," where interested candidates can send their profiles.
